notes: Game abilities that real sign-offs unlock (framework section 5). The real technique names come from the school's curriculum; these are the generic powers they map to, in belt order. The 1st belt's kata unlocks forms[1], the 2nd belt's forms[2], and so on; each belt's kick combo unlocks the next strike; each self-defense technique unlocks the next seal (5 per belt). forms[0] is the Beginner's Stance everyone starts with. Belts beyond the end of a list still unlock their ability, with its power arriving in a later update. Effect types are listed in packages/sim/src/effects.ts. Virtues: each stripe word maps to one Virtue. The reason behind each choice is in docs/decisions.md (milestone 4).

forms.name: Rooted Form
forms.text: Feet planted: 2 extra ticks to Perfect Counter and less damage taken, but 15% slower.

forms.name: Flowing Form
forms.text: Light on your feet: move 15% faster and attack 20% faster.

strikes.name: Follow-up Kick
strikes.text: Your Strike adds a second kick.

strikes.name: Quick Combo
strikes.text: Practiced combos flow smoothly: Strikes cost 8 less Focus.

seals.name: Off-Balance
seals.text: Perfect Counters leave the attacker off-balance half a second longer.

seals.name: Escape Step
seals.text: A Block instantly recharges Dash, so you can get away.

seals.name: Sweep
seals.text: Perfect Counters also knock into enemies close by.

seals.name: Sharp Eyes
seals.text: The Perfect Counter window is 1 tick longer.

seals.name: Create Distance
seals.text: Blocks shove the attacker back, bouncing 20% of the hit back at them.

seals.name: Disarm
seals.text: After a Perfect Counter, that attacker's next attack does half damage.

virtues.name: Shield of Respect
virtues.text: A shield that soaks up {n} damage for {s} seconds.

virtues.name: Second Wind
virtues.text: Restores {pct} of your Health and gives back half your Focus.

virtues.name: Perfect Discipline
virtues.text: For {s} seconds, every Counter is a Perfect Counter.
